Method of Attack: Data wiping beyond recovery masquerading as ransomware
Creates scheduled tasks to run every five minutes
Contacts command and control server to receive run or do not run commands
Stops critical processes related to MySQL, MS SQL, MS Exchange, and MS Active Directory
Deletes shadow copies to prevent restoration
Modifies Windows Registry to prevent RDP connections
Corrupts enumerated files except certain extensions and skips system directories
Uses Mersenne Twister pseudorandom number generator for file corruption
Generates ransom notes demanding Bitcoin but data cannot be restored
Impacted Systems: Systems running MySQL, MS SQL database servers, MS Exchange email servers, MS Active Directory web services
